metaTitle: Custom Touch Screen Magnets | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Brand your business with custom touch screen magnets. Durable, printable, and perfect for bulk orders from Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom touch screen magnets combine the functionality of a promotional magnet with a smooth surface that works with capacitive touch screens. Unlike standard magnets, these feature a compatible coating so recipients can keep notes and schedules visible without removing their phone case. Ideal for trade show giveaways, real estate agents, or any brand that wants daily visibility on smartphones. Decorate with full-color imprinting for a sleek, professional look.
heroAltText: Custom touch screen magnets with full-color imprinting on a smartphone case
